sections.overview: This small hylid frog is endemic to Ilha dos Alcatrazes off southeastern Brazil; ASW currently places it as Ololygon alcatraz.
sections.identification: The cited catalogue documents its island locality but gives little identification detail.
sections.habitat: It inhabits bromeliads on its small offshore island, where water collects between the leaves.
sections.diet: The sources consulted focus on its range and conservation and do not establish a species-specific diet.
sections.behavior: Its advertisement call was formally described in a 2024 study.
sections.reproduction: The frog is bromeligenous, using bromeliad water-holding leaf axils for reproduction.
sections.ecology: The 2015 study places it with S. arduous in the bromeliad-associated Scinax perpusillus group.
sections.conservation: An IUCN report says its status improved from Critically Endangered to Vulnerable in 2020 after habitat protection and management.
